props.name: itemId
props.description: Stable key for an entry. Index keys break as soon as the order changes.

props.name: renderItem
props.type: (item: T, state: { selected: boolean; distance: number }) => ReactNode
props.description: Renders the face of one card.

props.name: cardWidth
props.description: Card width in pixels. The track height follows the tallest card.

props.name: spread
props.description: Horizontal step between neighbours, in pixels.

props.name: rotation
props.description: Degrees a side card turns away from the viewer.

props.name: perspective
props.description: Perspective depth. Lower is a stronger effect.

props.name: depth
props.description: Cards drawn either side of the selected one.
